body:
Findings of the two-way review of B3 (T-293) and B4 (T-294). No P1/P2; these P3s are fixed in one
pass before the multi-account work is considered done.

1. Accounts screen order: the local area is sorted by sortOrder there (a server account added
   afterwards sorts below it) while the overview and the Copy-to picker use overviewOrder (local
   last). Build the Accounts rows with overviewOrder and give the local row no up/down arrows.
2. android/core/README.md: the new ListKind/duplicate bullet was inserted in the middle of the
   SyncEngine bullet; move "SyncStatus.state is the worst of the accounts…" back where it belongs.
3. Settings on a phone with no server account still shows the collaborator-change notification
   switch and "Last background sync": hide both when no server account exists.
4. "Use without an account" tapped twice quickly can skip the one-time note (the second create()
   returns false and sets localAreaChosen): a busy flag / disabled button while it runs, and the
   note shown from the first result only.
5. Back after a copy or after deleting a local list, when the app cold-started on the last opened
   list: popUpTo(OVERVIEW) removes nothing because OVERVIEW is not on the stack, so Back lands on the
   source list's properties. Pop to graph.startDestinationId instead (predates B4; fix it now).
6. Tests: the New-list dialog with the local area preselected (last opened list is local); the new
   local ListPropsScreenTest cancels its viewModelScope; addLocal's one-per-phone test runs two
   calls concurrently so deleting localMutex would fail it.
7. The local area's "removable only when empty" rule lives only in the view model: recount its
   undeleted lists inside AccountRegistry.remove's transaction for a non-server account and refuse
   (return false / throw IllegalStateException) if any remain; the view model shows the existing
   blocked text.
8. AuthRepository.login with LoginExpectation.Account(<local id>) would turn the local row into a
   half-server row; treat a non-server row like a missing one (refuse with WrongAccountException).
9. The copy's " (Copy)" name suffix is not localised on either client; the name is synced data, so
   the creator's language is the right one. Android: a string resource in nine locales passed into
   ListsRepo.duplicate (core cannot read resources; take the suffix as a parameter); web: the same
   message key in the nine catalogs (identical English "(Copy)" so crossClient pairs them).
title: B3/B4 review follow-ups: Accounts order of the local area, empty-only removal in the repo, localised copy suffix, small gaps
